summary: Iteration 2 full regression + new feature testing. Backend: 56/56 pytest green (29 regression from iter_1 + 27 new tests covering Razorpay mock-mode, Family sharing full flow, Smart Albums). Frontend: Login brand (white-lotus-on-blue logo, yellow Sign in and yellow Continue with Google buttons), /plans MOCKED banner, mock checkout dialog with correct GST (₹199 personal -> ₹234.82 total), /family page (seats 1 of 4, open Family Files link, invite form, 2 member rows), /photos Smart Albums tab (2 album cards appearing), mobile 390px layout with family header icon all verified live on https://nest-storage.preview.emergentagent.com.

minor.issue: Error text for free/starter plan says 'Upgrade to the Family or Business plan to invite members' - matches UI expectation, but a stricter 403 (plan gating) rather than 400 would be more semantically correct. Current 400 is acceptable.
ensure_quota uses owner.plan but owner object loaded fresh via db.users.find_one; if quota changes mid-request there is a small race window. Non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: billing_admin.py mark_paid is written to be idempotent via find_one_and_update guard on status='created' — good, race-safe for webhook + verify.
family.py in_shared walks up the folder tree per request; for deep trees this is O(depth) MongoDB lookups. For small hierarchies this is fine; consider caching ancestor set if folders become deep.

albums.py build_albums loads up to 20,000 media docs per request and recomputes clusters on every /api/albums and /api/albums/{id} call. For large libraries this will become slow — consider caching per user with a lazy invalidation on upload/delete.
family.py seats() uses plan.get('members', 1) - 1; business plan is 24 (25-1) and family 4 (5-1) per DEFAULT_PLANS. Verified by test_demo_family_overview (seats_total==4).
billing_admin.py plans endpoint returns razorpay_key_id only in live mode — payment_mode='mock' used by Plans.jsx to render the MOCKED banner. Both paths tested.
test_credentials: admin@kuvanest.com/Admin@12345, demo@kuvanest.com/Demo@12345 (Family plan), mem1@kuvanest.com/Member@123 (editor member of demo). All preserved per request.
